title: 08. 딥러닝 다중분류 - 실무전용 문제 모음
setup_code:
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import tensorflow as tf

tf.random.set_seed(100)
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

wine = pd.read_csv('data/wine.csv')
X = wine.drop(columns=['target'])
y = wine['target']
class_num = y.nunique()
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.2, stratify=y, random_state=42)
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_train_s = scaler.fit_transform(X_train)
X_test_s = scaler.transform(X_test)
X_train.shape

practices.answer_code:
from tensorflow.keras.models import Sequential
from tensorflow.keras.layers import Dense
model = Sequential()
model.add(Dense(32, activation='relu', input_shape=(X_train_s.shape[1],)))
model.add(Dense(16, activation='relu'))
model.add(Dense(8, activation='relu'))  # 은닉층을 여러 겹 쌓을수록 더 복잡한 패턴을 학습할 수 있지만 과적합 위험도 커짐
model.add(Dense(class_num, activation='softmax'))  # 다중분류 출력층: 노드 수=클래스 수, softmax
model.compile(optimizer='adam', loss='sparse_categorical_crossentropy', metrics=['accuracy'])
model.summary()

from tensorflow.keras.callbacks import EarlyStopping
es = EarlyStopping(monitor='val_loss', patience=10, restore_best_weights=True)
model.fit(X_train_s, y_train, epochs=100, batch_size=16, validation_data=(X_test_s, y_test), callbacks=[es], verbose=0)
pred_label = np.argmax(model.predict(X_test_s), axis=1)  # predict가 반환하는 클래스별 확률 벡터에서 argmax로 최종 클래스를 뽑아냄
print(pred_label[:10])

from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, confusion_matrix
print(accuracy_score(y_test, pred_label))
cm = confusion_matrix(y_test, pred_label)  # 클래스 개수만큼 NxN 행렬이 반환됨
sns.heatmap(cm, annot=True, fmt='d', cmap='Purples')
plt.show()

practices.prompt_markdown: `pred_label`을 사용해 macro 평균 f1-score와 precision을 구하세요. (다중분류에서는 클래스별 결과를 `average='macro'`로 평균 내는 것이 표준입니다)
practices.answer_code:
from sklearn.metrics import f1_score, precision_score
print(f1_score(y_test, pred_label, average='macro'))  # 다중분류는 average 옵션을 꼭 지정해야 계산됨
print(precision_score(y_test, pred_label, average='macro'))

practices.prompt_markdown: 은닉층을 하나 줄인(32→class_num) `model2`를 만들어 학습시키고, `model`(문제 2)과 accuracy를 비교하세요.
practices.answer_code:
model2 = Sequential()
model2.add(Dense(32, activation='relu', input_shape=(X_train_s.shape[1],)))
model2.add(Dense(class_num, activation='softmax'))
model2.compile(optimizer='adam', loss='sparse_categorical_crossentropy', metrics=['accuracy'])
es2 = EarlyStopping(monitor='val_loss', patience=10, restore_best_weights=True)
model2.fit(X_train_s, y_train, epochs=100, batch_size=16,
           validation_data=(X_test_s, y_test), callbacks=[es2], verbose=0)
pred_label2 = np.argmax(model2.predict(X_test_s), axis=1)
print('model  accuracy:', accuracy_score(y_test, pred_label))
print('model2 accuracy:', accuracy_score(y_test, pred_label2))  # 은닉층을 줄이면 보통 표현력이 줄어 성능이 같거나 낮아짐

practices.prompt_markdown: `model`에 대해 `classification_report`로 클래스별 precision/recall/f1을 한 번에 출력하세요.
practices.answer_code:
from sklearn.metrics import classification_report
print(classification_report(y_test, pred_label))  # 옵션 없이도 클래스별 precision/recall/f1을 한 번에 보여줌
